recognize_zh: 視野中以原始細胞為主，其間有數個巨核細胞，細胞質淡染顆粒狀但核呈單一圓形、不分葉且體積偏小（mononuclear/hypolobated megakaryocytes），是 AML with inv(3) 常見的巨核細胞發育異常。
features: Predominance of medium to large blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and a rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Megakaryocytes with single round to oval non-lobated nuclei and pale granular cytoplasm
Megakaryocytes are small relative to normal mature megakaryocytes
Occasional maturing neutrophils and small lymphocytes
No Auer rods clearly identified at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen dominated by medium to large blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm. Several megakaryocytes are present with single round, non-lobated nuclei and pale granular cytoplasm, and are smaller than normal mature forms. Maturing granulocytes are reduced. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with megakaryocytic dysplasia, suggestive of AML with inv(3)/t(3;3) (GATA2::MECOM) in the appropriate cytogenetic context.

ddx.vs: Dysplastic mononuclear megakaryocytes occur in both, so cytogenetics showing 3q26 MECOM rearrangement is required to classify as inv(3) AML.
del(5q) MDS has hypolobated megakaryocytes but lacks the large blast population present in this field.
AMKL blasts show cytoplasmic blebs and CD41/CD61 expression, while the blasts here are accompanied by, not composed of, megakaryocytic cells.
